\ubblockdescription{interrogation.cycle_shapes}{EXPERIMENTAL: not yet run on a real recording. For a chain of drops: every cycle (one drop to the next) is stretched to one length, lined up, and sorted into shapes (Colominas \& Wu 2023, the back half), so you can see whether all cycles share one shape or a few kinds, and where in the chain the kind changes. More than one kind is claimed only when the best split beats the same split on pseudo-cycles cut from the recording's quiet stretches and is two modes along its own direction - a shape that drifts steadily (a plateau that lengthens) stays one family, visible in the per-cycle measures. A chain that fills its span has no quiet stretch: its verdicts are then untested and said so. Per cycle: length, size, the share of the cycle on its floor (a sharkfin sits there for 1/2-2/3) and where it is half back. Coherence is SVD entropy, sigma\textasciicircum{}2 first and the paper's eq. 17 beside it, each against pseudo-cycles cut from the recording's own quiet stretches; a group no better than those is marked \textasciitilde{}noise\_like. Bind 'waveform' to the root signal when the detector ran on a short-detrended trace. Tune max\_cycle\_s first if many cycles are left out as gaps. Put it after Event shape and Trains (maxinterval at chain-scale gaps), before Intervals.}

  \ubparam{max\_\allowbreak{}cycle\_\allowbreak{}s}{0.0}{number from 0 to 10000000}{A cycle longer than this (s) is a gap, not a cycle: left out and counted. 0 = auto: longer than 1.6 x the running median of the 11 cycle lengths around it (a missed detection reads \textasciitilde{}2x)}%
  \ubparam{min\_\allowbreak{}cycle\_\allowbreak{}s}{0.0}{number from 0 to 10000000}{A cycle shorter than this (s) is a split drop: left out and counted. 0 = auto: shorter than 0.4 x that running median}%
  \ubparam{cycle\_\allowbreak{}detrend}{\texttt{chord}}{one of \texttt{chord}, \texttt{none}}{chord: subtract the straight line between the pre-drop levels at the cycle's two ends (the median of the 2 \% before each anchor), so drift does not tilt a cycle; none: cut as is}%
  \ubparam{n\_\allowbreak{}points}{256}{whole number from 32 to 2048}{Points every cycle is stretched to (the Library's 256)}%
  \ubparam{max\_\allowbreak{}shift\_\allowbreak{}frac}{0.1}{number from 0 to 0.4}{Most a cycle may be shifted to line up, as a fraction of its length (both the anchor refinement and the alignment)}%
  \ubparam{max\_\allowbreak{}iter}{8}{whole number from 0 to 50}{Most refinement rounds (the paper's examples needed 1-8); a round is kept only while the SVD entropy falls by more than its own bootstrap spread}%
  \ubparam{k\_\allowbreak{}max}{6}{whole number from 2 to 20}{Most shape groups one sequence may be split into}%
  \ubparam{min\_\allowbreak{}cycles}{10}{whole number from 4 to 100000}{Fewest usable cycles a sequence needs before it is grouped (and the smallest group a split may make)}%
  \ubparam{sigclust\_\allowbreak{}draws}{20}{whole number from 0 to 5000}{Gaussian draws of SigClust's null (the stack's own covariance). Reported only: it does not decide K}%
  \ubparam{null\_\allowbreak{}draws}{20}{whole number from 0 to 1000}{Background-null draws: pseudo-cycles cut where no event lies, through the same pipeline; they calibrate the split (K) and the groups' verdict. 0 = untested (every key \textasciitilde{}untested; K is then calibrated on 20 phase copies of the cycles)}%
  \ubparam{n\_\allowbreak{}perm}{1000}{whole number from 0 to 100000}{Shuffles of the cycle order for the order test}%
